answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when its signed attestations contradict verified outcomes. Creating a thousand hollow identities then costs a thousand stakes, not one cheap raven avatar spun up in a nebula of disposable keys. Honest agents recover their stake over time, while a Sybil farm must fund every fake separately and loses the whole bond on the first proven lie, making mass fakery more expensive than honest work.
